input.objective: prioritize modular candidates under the preserved C5a mechanism

messages.content: Execute a software contract, not a biological prediction. Return one JSON object and no prose. Payload input_origin must be synthetic_contract or existing_tool_result: other nonblank origin -> stop INVALID_INPUT_ORIGIN; missing origin -> request. Unknown keys/wrong JSON types/nonfinite numbers -> stop INVALID_PAYLOAD. Explicit stops precede missing facts. All missing facts: action=request_information, error_codes=[MISSING_INFORMATION], missing_fields=unique dotted/indexed field paths. Stops: action=stop, one first applicable error code, missing_fields=[]. Run: no errors/missing fields. For stop/request plan/result=null; run has the task object. All rationales must be nonempty; wording is free. Tools are unique sets. Numbers use abs1e-8 and rel1e-6 tolerance. Do not invent observations or clinical efficacy. In order: unknown constraint key -> UNKNOWN_CONSTRAINT; invalid positive-integer length or registered terminal lists -> INVALID_CONSTRAINTS; min_length>max_length(default1000) -> CONTRADICTORY_CONSTRAINTS. Only C5a,C5,P01031,complement C5/C5a (case-insensitive) are supported -> otherwise UNSUPPORTED_TARGET. Duplicate tool items -> DUPLICATE_TOOLS; unregistered name -> UNKNOWN_TOOL. Required database tools protein_sequence,target_information and expert tools esm,properties must be available -> REQUIRED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE; requested optional tools not available -> REQUESTED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Missing disease,target or available-tool lists -> request. Run uses target_query=trimmed target, accession=P01031, library_profile=c5a_modular_v21, tool sets=required union requested. Original six plan fields stay inside plan.
